posts.subject: Plugin to remove the MOTD
posts.bodyHtml:
Hey Dream,


Today I found a really cool plugin for sourcemod, it's just a .smx file which you have to place in the folder ofcourse.



The plugin does the following:
It blocks the MOTD from popping up when joining the server (so you don't have to click "Continue") every time. It's a really simple plugin but very useful :P.


Thanks for reading, cya.
